name: What are the signs of water damage on laminate flooring?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of water damage on laminate flooring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Key signs of water damage on laminate flooring include visible swelling, cupping, or buckling of the planks. You might also notice discolored spots, dark stains, or a hazy appearance on the surface. Another indicator is a soft, spongy feel when walking on the floor, or a musty odor indicating potential mold growth beneath. Gaps appearing between planks where there were none before also suggest moisture intrusion.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs include swelling, buckling, discoloration, a spongy feel, gaps between planks, and musty odors.
